$comment: no-tiny-text override for design-system showcase: 10px Micro Label is a documented, sanctioned step of the type scale (see TypeScale.tsx), not an accessibility bug. Suppression approved by Bora 2026-07-12. Scoped to this directory only via ignore.overrides so genuinely-too-small text elsewhere still gets flagged. TaskBoard is the visual-locked flagship board; split deferred by Bora 2026-07-16 (regression risk on animation wiring outweighs readability gain). div+role="button" a11y pattern follows the WTC in-repo precedent; real <button> conversion rejected 2026-07-16 (visual-locked DS, nested-interactive semantics); keyboard parity implemented via onKeyDown. 2026-08-01 (PR #59): render-helper no-render-in-render suppressed on Calendar/WorkflowAddElements (visual-locked flagship, child-component conversion risks key/animation regressions); no-long-transition-duration suppressed on DynamicIslandReader (1800ms diShine is a deliberate infinite ambient shimmer, not a one-shot transition); use-lazy-motion suppressed on DragDismissSheet (sole framer-motion consumer in the DS, LazyMotion provider not worth it for one showcase component); DragDismissSheet added to prefer-tag-over-role list for the decorative full-bleed scrim role=button.
